info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Public Finance

description.describe_ch: 本課程目的在於培養學生於國際商業情境中之英語溝通能力，包括會議與工作情境之聽、說能力的表達，英文簡報之設計與報告，商用英文書信之撰寫往來，工作團隊間之溝通。
description.describe_eh:
The goal of this course is to develop students' ability in English communication in different international business scenarios.
This course includes verbal communications in the meetings and various business scenarios, designing slides for English presentations, making English presentations, writing English business letters, communicating and cooperating in English in work teams.

targets.describe_ch: 能在各種商業情境中以英文溝通，包括聽、說、讀、寫之能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to communicate in English in different business scenarios.

targets.describe_ch: 以英文在工作團隊中協調合作
targets.describe_en: Cooperate in English in the work team

targets.describe_ch: 以英文在會議中表達意見與討論
targets.describe_en: Express the opinions and discuss with others in English in the meetings

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上不准使用影印及盜版教材。上課期間在課堂上不得吃食，不得趴睡。若有需要短暫休息或進食，可以暫時離開教室，相關事宜若已完成或排除，應盡快返回課堂上課。
Photocopied and pirated teaching materials are not allowed in class. Students are not allowed to eat or sleep in class during class. If you need to take a short break or eat, you can leave the classroom temporarily. If the relevant matters have been completed or eliminated, you should return to the classroom as soon as possible.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Students are not allowed to use pirated teaching materials in class. Students are not allowed to eat or sleep in the class. If needed,  you can take a short break after permission.
